newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK long-end govt paper yields lower, trace U.S..
newsitem.headline: HK long-end govt paper yields lower, trace U.S..

text.p: Long-end Hong Kong government paper yields dropped on Wednesday in line with overnight falls in U.S. Treasuries yields, dealers said.
Yields for seven-year Exchange Fund notes fell to 7.00 percent from 7.06 at Tuesday's midsession.
Five-year notes yielded 6.68 percent versus 6.71, and three-year notes yielded 6.12 percent versus 6.15 percent.
Short-dated Exchange Fund papers were stable, with one-week bills yielding 4.95 percent versus 4.94.
Interbank rates was sluggish as investors watched the results of U.S. presidential election, dealers said.
